name: stall-detection
label: S6 stall rule
title: mission_get flags an old, idle active mission stale — derived only, never written; a dead legacy draft reads active and stale
description: T358 S6, design §8: stale := status == 'active' && now - lastEvidenceAt > 1h && no linked session working — and design §3: that flag is DERIVED, never written back to the stored status. Mission v3 §3.4: a legacy `draft` file reads `active` everywhere, so a dead one (no children, last write hours ago) reads active AND stale — and the read still never writes the file. Missions are SEEDED (a scripted session cannot wait out an hour, and no verb writes a legacy file): stall-old (active, 2 h old, fixed end linked to a child C that is not running), stall-fresh (active, 5 min old, same link), stall-draft (a LEGACY draft — fixed start, no approval stamp — 5 h old), stall-recovers (active, 3 h old) and stall-ledger (active, only records probes). Agent A reads the missions through the real transport and writes one mission_log entry on stall-recovers. Because `derived.stale` has no file state, `probe` phases have the HARNESS call mission_get itself and log `EVAL-PROBE[<tag>] <slug> stale=<b> status=<s>` into the ledger — graded from the files, no model transcribing the value. The grade then requires: stall-old flagged stale while its file still says `active` with the seeded `updatedAt` (a read never writes), fresh not flagged, the legacy draft read as active and stale while its file still says `draft` (normalization happens on read, not by rewriting), and stall-recovers flagged before its log entry and clear after it. The 'a linked session is working' branch needs a live hook FSM and is pinned by the unit suite (tests/mission-derived-signals.test.ts).

phases.prompt:
1. mcp__harnu__mission_get with folder="{{folder}}", missionId="{{m.stall-old.id}}".
2. mcp__harnu__mission_get with folder="{{folder}}", missionId="{{m.stall-fresh.id}}".
3. mcp__harnu__mission_get with folder="{{folder}}", missionId="{{m.stall-draft.id}}".
4. mcp__harnu__mission_log with folder="{{folder}}", missionId="{{m.stall-recovers.id}}", note="EVAL-STALL-RECOVERED: back on it".

assert.label: old + idle-linked active mission is flagged stale
a read never writes the flag: stored status stays active
a read never writes the flag: updatedAt untouched
a read never writes the flag: the Log is untouched
a mission with fresh evidence is not flagged
a dead legacy draft reads active — and stale (v3 §3.4)
stall-recovers was stale before its log entry
a new mission_log entry clears the flag on the next read
a read never rewrites the legacy draft: its file still says draft
a read never rewrites the legacy draft: updatedAt untouched
